self_review.scope_and_completeness: Exact84 slots,16 supported groups; identity and duplicate checks; all derived flags/reasons/differences checked; independent fsum/variance calculation.
self_review.missing_values: None and booleans are type-sensitive; integer/count fields exact; no zero replacement or available-case group mean.
self_review.paths_and_integrity: Explicit trusted source-manifest SHA before payload parse; exact flat five-file whitelist; no symlink escape; input hashes rechecked before/after writing. Relative evidence keys are validated but never opened.
self_review.privacy: Exact container/field whitelists; core projection equality rejects unknown dict fields and malformed nested scalar containers; no actual private workspace paths in code package. Test strings are artificial rejection cases.
self_review.claims: Standalone projection/aggregate replay only. Original worker execution, raw metric rescoring and CV verification remain outside scope. Source manifest provenance does not by itself prove authentic execution.
self_review.publication_boundary: Code and plan only; no input-data bundle, actual replay, manuscript changes, Resource4 changes or upload.

authorization_wording_correction.change: Separate existing user authorization from publication execution. Publication is already authorized; none was performed during code-only preparation. No new user permission is required.
